description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkAudioPlayer component, including tests to ensure playback does not hang and functions as expected under certain conditions, along with utility functions for generating sample WAV data and handling timeouts.

classes.name: TalkAudioPlayerTests
classes.description: A suite of tests for the TalkAudioPlayer, including testing playback behavior and concurrency handling.

classes.name: TimeoutError
classes.description: A custom error type used to indicate a timeout occurrence.

methods.name: play does not hang when playback ends or fails
methods.description: Tests that playback completes without hanging when it ends or fails.

methods.name: play does not hang when play is called twice
methods.description: Tests concurrent calls to play to ensure proper behavior without hanging.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Utility to run an async task with a timeout, throwing TimeoutError if it exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: makeWav16Mono
methods.description: Creates a byte array representing a mono 16-bit PCM WAV audio with specified sample rate and samples.
